# std.stream

<!-- Generated by `lang doc std` from the checked interfaces (lang 0.1.0). Do not edit by hand. -->

Suspending input streams (e.g. from channels). Unlike `Seq`, pulling from
a stream may wait, and a stream is consumed as it is read.

## Types

### `Stream`

```lang
struct Stream<T> { pub next: fn() -> Option<T> }
```

## Functions

### `collect`

```lang
fn collect<T>(s: Stream<T>) -> List<T> !{Wait}
```

Read every remaining item.

### `filter`

```lang
fn filter<T>(s: Stream<T>, keep: fn(T) -> Bool) -> Stream<T>
```

### `from_receiver`

```lang
fn from_receiver<T>(r: channel.Receiver<T>) -> Stream<T>
```

Messages from a receiver until it is closed and drained.

### `map`

```lang
fn map<T, U>(s: Stream<T>, f: fn(T) -> U) -> Stream<U>
```
